text: The admin user list loads only when asked for, and is sorted by email

Landed in 3a9d77b. Load on request: the console opens with the registration toggle only, a "Show registered users" button fetches the list, then a count plus Refresh; the step-up password field appears with the list since it only guards the per-user actions. One screen, no submenu. users is nullable on both clients (null = never asked). Sorted server-side: accounts.list_all_accounts now ends ORDER BY lower(accounts.email), reusing idx_accounts_email_lower; neither client re-sorts; wire contract documents the order. Three new string pairs in all nine locales (action.refresh, admin.showUsers, admin.userCount). Server test pins the order with emails that sort differently by created_at and again by raw byte order. Mutation-checked on server and both clients. Gate green.
